meta.idConvention: tagbench-NNNN is the 1-based row number of the source JSONL.
meta.durationDefinition: Actual WAV frame count / sample rate; total hours summed once per query.
meta.countDefinition: Number of original semicolon-separated annotated intervals, before merging.
meta.coverageDefinition: Length of the interval union intersected with the recording / WAV duration.
meta.audioTransform: Full recording; mono MP3, 32 kHz, 64kbps; no cropping, original time origin.
meta.waveform: 3000 normalized peak bins from mono 8 kHz PCM.
meta.spectrogram: 8 kHz PCM; 512-sample Hann window; 128-sample hop; mean linear power per time column; -65 to 0 dB relative to per-recording peak; 0–4 kHz.
meta.curation: 16 examples: one single-target and one multi-target query per task. The gallery is curated, not a random representative sample.
